doc.title: George Wein interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001

title: Wrapping up the interview
summary: Rowe thanks him and Wein says he enjoys talking.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Wow. That’s a good statement. And I appreciate you making it. I’m going to get you on your way here.
You get me to talk. I love to talk. I like things like this because I can say whatever the hell I want.
